first_step_test: One large rounded square with a parallel inset edge gives the learner a useful connected waffle silhouette in its final tilted position before toppings and grid lines arrive.

source.notes: Planned six-panel direct felt-tip marker contact sheet for the September 10 current lesson. National Waffle Week supplied a natural timely hook; preserve rejected iterations privately.

final_elements.name: waffle outer contour
final_elements.description: One large slightly tilted rounded-square waffle outline with softly notched corners.

final_elements.name: waffle inset edge
final_elements.description: One parallel inset line following all four sides inside the outer contour.

final_elements.name: syrup pool
final_elements.description: One irregular syrup pool across the upper-right waffle surface.

final_elements.name: left syrup drip
final_elements.description: Short rounded drip descending from the syrup pool near its left edge.

final_elements.name: center syrup drip
final_elements.description: Longest rounded drip descending from the center of the syrup pool.

final_elements.name: right syrup drip
final_elements.description: Short rounded drip descending near the right edge of the syrup pool.

final_elements.name: butter pat
final_elements.description: One small tilted rectangular butter pat resting inside the syrup pool.

final_elements.name: butter highlight
final_elements.description: One narrow open-paper highlight inside the upper butter edge.

final_elements.name: syrup highlight
final_elements.description: One curved open-paper highlight inside the right side of the syrup pool.

final_elements.name: vertical groove 1
final_elements.description: Left exposed vertical waffle groove stopping at syrup and inset edges.

final_elements.name: vertical groove 2
final_elements.description: Center-left exposed vertical waffle groove stopping at syrup and inset edges.

final_elements.name: vertical groove 3
final_elements.description: Center-right exposed vertical waffle groove stopping at syrup and inset edges.

final_elements.name: horizontal groove 1
final_elements.description: Upper exposed horizontal waffle groove stopping at syrup and inset edges.

final_elements.name: horizontal groove 2
final_elements.description: Middle exposed horizontal waffle groove stopping at syrup and inset edges.

final_elements.name: horizontal groove 3
final_elements.description: Lower exposed horizontal waffle groove stopping at inset edges.

final_elements.name: crumb mark 1
final_elements.description: Small angular crumb below the lower-left waffle corner.

final_elements.name: crumb mark 2
final_elements.description: Small round crumb below the waffle center.

final_elements.name: crumb mark 3
final_elements.description: Small angular crumb to the lower-right of the waffle.

final_elements.name: ground shadow
final_elements.description: One short broken shadow beneath the waffle and three crumbs.

frames.visible_job: Draw one large tilted rounded square with four softly notched corners and a parallel inset line inside all four edges.
frames.instruction: Draw one large rounded square tilted slightly clockwise. Soften each corner with a shallow notch, then follow all four sides with one parallel inset line to show the waffle's thick edge.

frames.visible_job: Add one irregular syrup pool across the upper-right surface with three separate rounded drips descending from it.
frames.instruction: Across the upper-right waffle surface, draw one irregular syrup pool. Pull exactly three rounded drips downward from its lower edge: a short left drip, one longer center drip, and a short right drip.

frames.visible_job: Place one tilted butter pat inside the syrup pool and reserve one highlight in the butter plus one in the syrup.
frames.instruction: Inside the syrup pool, draw one small tilted rectangular pat of butter. Add one narrow highlight inside its upper edge and one curved highlight inside the pool on the right; keep both shapes enclosed and open for white paper.

frames.visible_job: Draw three vertical and three horizontal grooves across exposed waffle areas, stopping every line at syrup and inset edges.
frames.instruction: Draw exactly three vertical grooves and three horizontal grooves across the exposed waffle. Stop each groove cleanly when it meets the syrup pool or inset edge instead of drawing through the topping.

frames.visible_job: Add exactly three small crumbs below the waffle and one short broken ground shadow while preserving every topping and groove.
frames.instruction: Below the waffle, add exactly three small crumbs: one angular crumb at lower left, one round crumb near center, and one angular crumb at lower right. Draw one short broken ground shadow beneath them without touching the waffle edge.

final_step.visible_job: Add golden, amber, yellow, coral, and navy marker fills only inside the established shapes.
final_step.instruction: Fill the waffle golden yellow, deepen the inset edge and grooves with warm coral-orange, color the syrup amber, and fill the butter bright yellow. Leave both enclosed highlights white, color the three crumbs golden, and deepen the existing broken shadow with navy. Keep visible marker strokes and add no new outlines.
adds: golden amber yellow coral and navy marker fills

visual_review.draw_through_observation: All six saved crops were reviewed at full size. Each transition adds only its assigned forms; the topping anchors, interrupted groove routes, exact drip and crumb counts, and open-paper highlights persist into the warm marker finish.
